notes: Account overview: enterprise legal-tech vendor building semantic search for contract corpora and regulatory materials.
Primary objective: replace slow keyword index + expensive downstream reranker with unified embeddings + reranking flow that hits latency targets and reduces unit cost.
Scale requirement: target index size 100M–1B vectors (initial POC 100M, production 500M+).
Latency targets: ANN retrieval <50ms median for 512-d embeddings; reranker end-to-end (retrieve + rerank + formatting) <200ms for top-5 candidates.
Throughput: expect ~2k qps burst across global regions; daily steady-state ~200 qps; peak batch re-index windows overnight for 50–200M docs.
Cost sensitivity: strong focus on $/query at scale; want batching, caching, quantization, and cheap cold storage for older embeddings.
Preferred models: open 7B–13B family for embeddings + distilled reranker; willing to consider Redwood-verified variants and quantized builds.
Routing needs: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU residency for EMEA customers); automatic fallback to cheaper model variants when Dedicated capacity constrained.
Data controls: require KMS integration, audit logs for query text, and retention controls for PII-sensitive contracts.

POC success metrics: ingest 100M vectors in 72 hours with <1.5x storage overhead, retrieval 99th pctl <120ms (ANN only), rerank 95% quality parity with baseline BERT reranker, and $/query below internal threshold.
Customer quotes: "If we can cut vector unit cost in half while hitting latency SLAs, this is strategic for us."
Interactions: mixed — engineering team pragmatic, procurement/legal conservative. AE notes: "Need to own the price math upfront; security review will move slow."
How Redwood fits: Dedicated for predictable throughput + Private for EMEA data residency; Optimize tooling to recommend quantization/batching profiles and expected $/query savings.
Risks: If ingest pipeline needs custom sharding or major network changes, timeline could slip. On-prem disk IO and GPU availability are unknown.
Ask list: 1) Example cost model for 500M vectors, 2) Runbook for incremental reindex, 3) SOW draft for Dedicated + On-prem pilot, 4) Live rerank perf test harness
use_case_summary: Large-scale RAG/search over contracts and regulatory docs. Core challenge: keep ANN retrieval latency low at 100M+ vectors while keeping $/query manageable via caching, batching, and quantization; reranker applied to top-K with strict quality checks.
poc_scope: 100M-vector ingest (parquet -> embeddings -> dedup -> sharded index) + end-to-end rerank perf run; measure storage overhead, ingest time, retrieval latency distribution, and per-query cost. Provide config recommendations (batch size, cache TTL, quantization profile).
technical_requirements: Vector index sharding and multi-region replication
Hardware: NVIDIA A10/A100 fleets for Dedicated; on-prem GPU kit compatibility notes
pricing_requirements: Need committed pricing bands for 0-250M, 250-750M, 750M+ vectors; clear $/query and storage tiers; options for annual commitment with burst buffer.
legal_and_compliance: Requires data residency in EU for EMEA customers; standard DPA with EU addendum; audit log retention 7 years for flagged contracts; willingness to sign ISO/SOC attestations post-SOW.
final_notes: High upside if POC proves cost reductions. Sales motion: consolidate Dedicated + Optimize + Security package into a single pilot SOW. Procurement timeline depends on security team but target close by 2025-01.
